comment: Voiceover script for the marketing video, wording and pausing set by the project owner. Order defines scene order. `clip` names the recorded footage (from record.mjs; an externally produced .mp4 with the same scene name wins over a missing .webm), `min`/`max` bound the scene length in seconds; the assembler stretches each scene to fit its narration. Optional `say` is the text actually sent to the TTS: pronunciation respellings ('Neuroster'→'Nerohster' = neh-ROH-ster, one flowing word, 'colony'→'coluny' = KOL-uh-nee single natural stress, 'biome'→'bi-ohm', 'automate'→'auto mate', 'somebody'→'sumbudy', 'thrive'→'thryve', 'materials'→'mateerials' (ma-TEER-ee-uhls), 'families'→'famlys' (FAM-leez), 'shovel'→'shuvvel' (SHUH-vul), 're-search', 'e-volve' — all verified via eSpeak IPA) and requested pauses as sentence breaks; `vo` stays the human-readable line.

scenes.vo: This is Neuroster, a world-building colony game where all of your workers happen to be hamsters.
scenes.say: This is Nerohster, a world-building coluny game where all of your workers, happen to be hamsters.

scenes.vo: You start by building a colony in a living world. Pick a biome you like — and your first few hamsters get right to work, digging, and settling in.
scenes.say: You start by building a coluny in a living world. Pick a bi-ohm you like. And your first few hamsters get right to work, digging, and settling in.

scenes.vo: Then you build — you automate — and thrive.
scenes.say: Then you build. You auto mate. And, thryve.

scenes.vo: You'll mine materials and refine them — grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops. And once the toil is automated, the whole colony really comes alive.
scenes.say: You'll mine mateerials and refine them. Grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops. And once the toil is automated, the whole coluny really comes alive.

scenes.vo: Every rodent here is a somebody. They've got names, families, and jobs to do. It's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.
scenes.say: Every rodent here is a sumbudy. They've got names, famlys, and jobs to do. It's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.

scenes.vo: Out here, the wild is always watching.
scenes.say: Out here, the wild is always watching.

scenes.vo: Predators, disasters, rival factions. So you'll raise a garrison, research new skills, and evolve your rodents to handle whatever comes.
scenes.say: Predators, disasters, rival factions. So you'll raise a garrison, re-search new skills, and e-volve your rodents to handle whatever comes.

scenes.vo: Neuroster. It's your colony — and your world. So grab a shovel, and start digging.
scenes.say: Nerohster. It's your coluny. And your world. So grab a shuvvel, and start digging.
